decision.problem: Tracking preparation currently vetoes the sole CLI-owned child on metadata failure.
decision.selected: Local typed preparation result and typed transport errors; one unchanged absolute deadline; same sole spawn path.
decision.alternative: General execution state machine or daemon-owned child; rejected because it adds ownership, descriptor/signal transfer and maintenance without a demonstrated need.
forbid: new service or CLI async runtime

preparationOutcomes.when: Valid matching REGISTER Registered and CLAIM Launching replies; same-invocation UNCHANGED permitted.
preparationOutcomes.postSpawn: Existing bounded ATTACH/COMPLETE and wait path.

preparationOutcomes.when: No lifecycle request may have reached daemon; all absence/refusal/unreachability attempts failed before possible delivery.
preparationOutcomes.diagnostic: Static TRACKING_UNAVAILABLE only after spawn success; no saved-record claim.

preparationOutcomes.when: Any request may have been delivered/committed, REGISTER confirmed with CLAIM lost, or DB_BUSY exhausted.
preparationOutcomes.diagnostic: Static TRACKING_UNCERTAIN only after success; opaque ID is not persistence proof.
preparationOutcomes.postSpawn: No REGISTER/CLAIM recovery, no ATTACH/COMPLETE against unconfirmed claim.

preparationOutcomes.when: Matching well-formed authenticated protocol-1 error other than DB_BUSY, including unknown codes.
preparationOutcomes.diagnostic: Static rejection, no raw response message or payload; exit failure.

preparationOutcomes.when: Wrong protocol/request ID, inconsistent envelope, malformed/missing lifecycle result, wrong key/owner/class/phase, complete malformed/empty/oversized frame.
preparationOutcomes.diagnostic: Static invalid/protocol diagnostic; do not relabel as outage.

preparationOutcomes.when: Invalid exec grammar, empty/missing program or NUL argv.
Cancellation during preparation or immediately before spawn.
preparationOutcomes.diagnostic: No command-started wording; retain signal conventions.

preparationOutcomes.when: Required supervision cannot be installed, invalid local configuration/authentication, or other non-outage local setup failure.
Single eligible native spawn attempt errors.
preparationOutcomes.diagnostic: Existing static SPAWN_FAILED; never claim child started.

transportPolicy.uncertainty: Monotone once any request bytes may be sent; retries cannot erase ambiguity; valid idempotent success may resolve it.

dbBusy.classification: Retryable authenticated metadata unavailable/uncertain, not definitive rejection or transport exception.
dbBusy.why: Existing admission/worker/deadline paths share this code; failure may follow COMMIT.
dbBusy.retry: Same action/request ID/job ID/observer/value within shared deadline.

transportPolicy.otherAuthenticatedErrors: Definitive non-launching Rejected, no silent outage conversion.
transportPolicy.invalidResponse: Non-launching InvalidReply, distinct from truncated disconnected transport.
transportPolicy.claimPrerequisite: Do not CLAIM without validated REGISTER.
transportPolicy.trustBoundary: Preserve existing daemon same-user admission and owner-only socket path; do not claim new mutual-authentication proof.

deadline.start: Before socket resolution, identity/key/classification and first metadata action, after argument validation and signal setup.
deadline.expiry: Unavailable or Uncertain by prior send history; no renewed action budget.
deadline.signalRisk: Shared-job quiet INT/QUIT handler needs pre-spawn cancellation observation while preserving one terminal delivery after attachment.

timingContract.required: Native parent-before-wrapper-spawn to child invocation marker/control handshake upper bound <=2000 ms, plus deterministic shared-deadline arithmetic.
timingContract.subdivisions: Record direct t_meta/decision/spawn times when available; otherwise null with reason. Proxy request arrival is not t_meta.
timingContract.noAdjustment: No scheduling-delay subtraction, fake zero overhead or wall-clock-only durations.
timingContract.commitProof: Real daemon DB phase/revision and proxy barrier after backend acknowledgement withheld from CLI.
timingContract.claim: Engineering target tested on recorded native host; no universal hard real-time promise.

preservation.assertions: Retain original bodies, attributes, helper inputs/protections and reachability; only exact fixture-routing recipes below may normalize to accepted items.
preservation.historicalEvidence: Keep original bytes and meanings; historical passes do not verify current fallback.

coverage.comparison: BigInt(covered)*100n >= BigInt(total)*80n for every crate with positive denominator
retain: fresh native LCOV and LLVM JSON

historicalAdapter.adapterBehavior: before_register returns input unchanged for every other mode; after_shutdown is allowed at one exact site. Replace program before stdio customization; preserve native args/env removals+values/cwd. No changes to original shared helpers or Proxy.
historicalAdapter.preparation: Materialize exact accepted Cargo root/config and crates into ignored isolated fixture; run cargo test -p arc-cli there with separate target; source/binary/toolchain hashes checked on reuse. Initialize once on ordinary workspace-test first use if absent. Record actual argv/cwd and positive no-skip test execution.
historicalAdapter.instrumentation: Historical preparation removes inherited instrumentation/target overrides; historical executable does not contribute to candidate production coverage. Never change current collector or profile accounting.
historicalAdapter.failure: Missing baseline, fixture mismatch, failed preparation or missing invocation proof is a blocker, never skipped.
historicalAdapter.guard: Reverse only these two unique recipes to accepted tokens; compare all baseline existing test/helper items and reachability including new-at-00773c69 tests. Reject ambiguous matches, extra callers and changed assertions/attributes/helpers. Keep old guards untouched.
historicalAdapter.negativeControl: Execute separate live fallback assertions against baseline binary and require their expected failure; do not count as a passing live run.

nativeCompatibilityEachOutage: child stderr bytes separate from static ARC guidance
signalsAndForeground: fallback TERM/HUP and actual signaled wait status
managedRetained: daemon loss survival and observational recovery
recoveryPrivacyScope: one invocation remains after real recovery and status
no persisted or diagnostic argv/environment secrets
unconfirmed ID does not imply saved record
testMatrix.synchronization: Real proxies/native control barriers; sleeps alone are not commit or invocation evidence.

implementationSurfaces.ownership: Needed by backend task-3 under saved assignment; this does not amend ownership or permit task-1 writes.
implementationSurfaces.conditionalRule: Use only for demonstrated need within backend saved scope; otherwise Chief coordinates. Shared-job pre-spawn INT/QUIT cancellation is an observed concrete need. Preserve original assertions/helpers. Prefer new modules to lengthening existing pipeline.rs.
otherSavedOwners: terminal.json (saved final/verification owner; backend implements recorder interface)

inputFingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256(JSON.stringify(files)); files is a lexicographically inserted object keyed by canonical relative path; values {sha256:file-byte-hash,mode:stat.mode & 0777}; regular files only.
inputFingerprint.untracked: Include all current files in scopes, not only tracked inventory. Missing required files fail final binding.
inputFingerprint.separateCoverageIdentity: Keep scripts/coverage/source.ts inputIdentity meaning unchanged; record both hashes rather than substituting one.
inputFingerprint.gitBinding: Record actual observed HEAD/tree, fixed baseline tree, current binary hashes and diff digest; do not replace missing supplied revisions. Before/after file fingerprints must match.

common.observedGit: actual HEAD/tree and baseline diff digest; optional actual supplied refs, never invented
common.tools: map of actual executable paths, exact version strings and version-command exit codes

artifactRef.rule: Required tracked evidence must be 100644 and equal index bytes at final validation.

command.skipFlags: literal false; no --skip, --ignored or skip env

command.stderrSha256: 64 lowercase hex digest of actual stderr
command.output: safe ignored local stdoutPath/stderrPath and hashes; no raw environment or command secrets

implementation/gates.json.passRule: All prerequisiteCommands executed successfully at current fingerprint; no skipped tests/checks; all native timing cases pass; historical/live separation valid; every crate meets exact 80%. This is implementation readiness, not complete mission acceptance.
implementation/gates.json.dependencyRule: Read only prerequisite command receipts, timing/historical/preservation/coverage observations and frozen inputs. Never read or require qa/review.*, final.json, terminal.json or terminal validator results; no own receipt/hash requirement.

timingCase.metadataElapsedMs: actual directly measured value or null with reason; never fabricate
timingCase.handoffMs: actual measured value or null with reason
timingCase.startupMs: actual measured value or null with reason

All sealed evidence matches index; total tracked evidence count remains <150. Final pass is necessary but acceptance also requires both actual terminal validators to exit zero and terminal.json.passed=true.
final.json.dependencyRule: Bind gates, timings, review/report, claims and predecessor observations by byte hash. Never reference or require terminal.json or terminal validator receipts. No rewrite after terminal validation begins unless upstream work changes and dependent validation is repeated.

terminal.json.sinkRule: Produced after terminal commands finish, from recorded real subprocess observations. No gate, QA, final or validator reads/requires this receipt for its own pass. It does not hash itself. Chief verifies it against actual terminal command results; writing passed=true is not proof. No later validator receipt is required to create it.
terminal.json.indexRule: Stage the completed sink after validation; preserve all sealed index bytes. Required upstream artifacts are already staged before validators run. The evidence validator accepts the sink being absent on first run and includes it in total count/type/index checks when present, without reading its verdict or requiring it. Sealed inventory excludes only this exact path; reserve its one slot before finalization.

verificationSchedule.focused: Run focused deterministic tests during implementation; freeze inputs before final gates.
verificationSchedule.coverageInventory: Existing coverage-verification.test.ts executes accounting.test.ts, gate.test.ts, hygiene-preservation.test.ts, hygiene.test.ts and preservation.test.ts; the four separately required files are listed in mandatoryCommands. All nine retained.
verificationSchedule.last: After real prerequisite checks: write immutable gates; execute gates validator and retain actual result outside gates; independent QA reproduces/reviews; write final decision and stage all sealed evidence; execute full evidence validator; write/stage terminal.json from actual validator observations. No predecessor depends on the terminal sink.
verificationSchedule.noSkips: No flags/env/fixtures bypass mandatory commands; historical assertions execute, never ignore.

orderedStages.action: Freeze complete current inputs including contracts, validators, help/docs and claims review; compute source fingerprint.

Run every prerequisiteCommands entry exactly, serialize collectors, then run live coverage evidence after last collector. Write real command/timing/historical/preservation receipts. Stage completed predecessor evidence only.
Assemble gates from actual prerequisite receipts and observations. No QA/final/terminal inputs.
Run exact gates terminal command; retain actual completed result locally for terminal sink; on failure repair and repeat affected stages.

Independent oma-qa reviews gates/predecessors, executes unfiltered workspace and native reproduction, writes/stages review/report and actual reproduction receipts. It does not require final/evidence-validator results.
Saved final owner writes final decision binding upstream hashes; stage all sealed evidence including final. Count sealed files <=148. Final does not bind terminal results.
Run exact evidence terminal command against actual staged sealed files. No own receipt/sink needed. Retain real result; failures block acceptance.

Write terminal.json from both completed validator observations; hash upstream artifacts, confirm no change, stage only completed sink, total <=149. Chief assesses final and real terminal outcomes together; no validating command recursively depends on sink.

verificationSchedule.hashDirection: current inputs -> prerequisite observations/command receipts -> gates -> independent review -> final -> terminal sink; terminal validator results flow only into terminal sink, never back into gates/review/final. Arrows mean predecessor binding, not that a predecessor hashes a successor.
verificationSchedule.failureRule: A failed terminal command means acceptance failed even if gates.passed or final.verdict previously read true. Retain actual failure, repair owned inputs, invalidate affected current-source receipts and repeat dependent stages. No placeholder artifacts, fixture acceptance, skipped checks or receipt-free pass.
verificationSchedule.coverageCollectorRule: Independent QA must not collect after the final live coverage check unless it reruns that check and regenerates affected coverage/gates/review/final bindings before terminal validation. Ordinary workspace reproduction is non-collecting.
verificationSchedule.terminalFiles: Exactly terminal.json is outside sealed artifact dependencies/inventory; it is still regular, tracked/index-equal, source-bound evidence counted toward <150 after creation. A later external command replay may replace only terminal results after successful observations, without changing sealed artifacts.

Execute real small fixture subprocesses, capture actual exits/output/PIDs/times and emit predecessor observations; never fabricate successful command receipts or run a production validator in a bypass mode. Fixture paths/kind/catalog identity must be rejected as production acceptance.

deliveryRepairInspection.finding: Supplied review identifies deliveryTree 98561a7310708c3c62527905d67362725925d159 as stale revision 1. Local revision 2 already contains the 11+2 partition, terminal sink and first-run case; retain these in both revision 3 files.
deliveryRepairInspection.codeIntelligence: Serena unavailable; scoped known-file reads and Git evidence only.
deliveryRepairInspection.scope: Only the two assigned contract files; no mission-state/changeSet metadata edits.
deliveryRepairInspection.deliveryLimit: Local bytes and final hash manifest are verifiable here; a later AV deliveryTree/changeSet is framework output and must be checked after capture, never invented.

contractValidation.meaning: Static validation of the actual contract documents and baseline bindings only; not product, timing or independent acceptance.

receiptDependencyGraph.meaning: Each node lists only required predecessor nodes, not successors. Gates and full evidence validators are terminal commands whose actual observations go only into terminal.json.
receiptDependencyGraph.controlFlow: The gates validator must actually pass before independent QA begins; that sequencing requirement adds no stored terminal receipt to gates/review/final. The evidence validator runs only after final and sealed evidence are staged.
receiptDependencyGraph.artifactReadRule: A node must be constructible and valid with all successor output files absent. Validators are read-only over existing predecessors. No required receipt hash, passed flag, index inventory or implicit glob may introduce a successor dependency.
receiptDependencyGraph.catalogRule: Preservation/docs prerequisite validators consume current inputs and existing historical/live observations only, never gates, QA, final or terminal. The unchanged full harness currently calls only bun run test:coverage; do not auto-discover the two terminal validators inside any prerequisite command.
receiptDependencyGraph.firstRunProof: Require the actual fixture-only first-run regression specified in commandPhases.firstRunCase, including rejection of graph cycles, successor reads, predecessor tampering and a failed terminal result relabeled pass. No production gate was run by this contract task.

requiredSemanticChecks: Both files describe revision 3, all 13 exact mandatory command arrays, disjoint 11+2 phases, first-run sequence and terminal sink.
receiptDependencyGraph is acyclic and its construction order reads no future artifact.
Gates commands cover only the 11 prerequisites. Final requires verdict/openBlockers and never a terminal receipt.
deliveryProtocol.captureRule: Freeze both completed files together. Report actual byte counts and SHA-256 values in the Actor handoff outside these self-hashed files. AV must generate a fresh changeSet/deliveryTree containing that pair; never reuse either rejected delivery manifest.
deliveryProtocol.integrationRule: Chief compares both captured path/byte/hash entries with the handoff, reads them from the actual deliveryTree, and reruns JSON/Markdown/command/DAG checks before admitting task-3. A mismatch is a delivery blocker, not authority to edit mission state or acceptance criteria.
deliveryProtocol.selfReferenceRule: Do not embed either current contract hash in its own contents. No fabricated delivery revision/changeSet, no separate unowned file, no changes to saved task instructions.
